title: ceammc.an
description: `ceammc.an` is an index for the ceammc analysis objects, covering onset and tempo detection, pitch tracking, moving-average RMS measurement, and zero-crossing calculations. Use its links to access help for objects such as `an.onset`, `an.onset~`, `an.pitchtrack~`, `an.rms~`, `an.tempo~`, and `an.zero~`.
